summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Unilever PLC reporting a director's share purchase under PDMR (Persons Discharging Managerial Responsibilities) rules. Non-Executive Director Zoe Yujnovich bought 345 ordinary shares at £44.18 each on May 1, 2026, for a total of £15,242.70. This is a standard regulatory disclosure of insider share dealings with no corporate event, structural change, or strategic action involved. The filing carries no M&A implications, board recommendations, or deal mechanics. This is not a special situation under a restructuring, acquisition, or capital returns category.
